checks.detail: Deletes jobs/renewal.ts. Priyanka agreed Oct 31 to keep it: 312 annual customers stop renewing, 9 of them tomorrow.

answers.renewal: jobs/renewal.ts runs at 02:00 and bills every annual plan whose period ends that day, then mails the receipt through the email service. 312 customers are on it. If it goes, they stop renewing.
answers.billing: Billing is the new service in the plan: Checkout starts an upgrade, the provider charges the card and calls Payment confirmed. The route must verify the sender and ignore repeats, or anyone could mark themselves paid.
answers.db: One new column, plan, on users: free, annual or pro. Migration 007 adds it with a default of free.
answers.email: Receipts, renewal notices and trial reminders. Codex's ACME-219 wants the trial reminders off.
